titulo.es: Un avión de Flydubai con destino Israel aterriza de emergencia en Arabia Saudita por un "incidente"
titulo.en: Israel-bound passenger plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after reported fight between pilots

sintesis.es: Un vuelo que conectaba Dubái con Tel Aviv debió posarse en Arabia Saudita con pasajeros israelíes a bordo. Varios medios de comunicación israelíes informaron sobre una pelea entre el piloto y el copiloto del avión, durante la cual se activó la señal de socorro de la aeronave.
sintesis.en: Israeli media say incident, which raised fears of possible hijacking, stemmed from feud between plane’s two pilots A commercial plane travelling from Dubai in the United Arab Emirates to Israel has been forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, after an apparent brawl between its pilots prompted distress signals that briefly raised fears of an attempted hijacking. The FlyDubai flight was over Jordan when it diverted to Saudi Arabia, transmitting three emergency signals, one of which indicated a possible unlawful interference. Continue reading...

titulo.es: Finanzas falseadas por casi 1.200 millones de dólares: el Manchester City, acorralado
titulo.en: Man City scandal: 'Sham' deals and inflated revenues

sintesis.es: Tal como lo anticipó ‘The Athletic’ el 25 de septiembre, la Premier League determinó que el City “rompió sistemáticamente las reglas” durante “casi una década”, proporcionando información financiera distorsionada con contratos comerciales falsos para inflar sus finanzas y proceder con varios de los fichajes más cuantiosos del fútbol. Estos son los hallazgos del panel independiente que descubrió cómo el cuadro ciudadano engañó a la liga inglesa.
sintesis.en: In what may be the biggest financial scandal in Premier League history, Manchester City have been found guilty of using "sham" commercial contracts as part of schemes to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than £900 million over nearly a decade, the Premier League said on Tuesday. The club, which denies wrongdoing, said in a statement that it would appeal.

titulo.es: ¿Está amparada por el derecho internacional la deportación a terceros países promovida por Trump?
titulo.en: AI companies sign voluntary accord on safety with Trump

sintesis.es: La Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos autorizó de forma temporal al Gobierno de Donald Trump a reanudar las deportaciones aceleradas de migrantes hacia países distintos a sus lugares de origen, mientras se analiza la legalidad definitiva de esta política. El derecho internacional cuestiona que las personas puedan ser enviados a países en los que pueden ser víctimas de crímenes. Haim Vásquez, abogado de inmigración y exfiscal criminal, aborda el tema en France 24.
sintesis.en: US President Donald Trump and leaders of major AI companies signed a voluntary accord Tuesday to strengthen safety as the technology faces growing public concern. The agreement calls for internal controls, independent audits and board oversight while Trump rejected calls for government restrictions and urged rapid AI development to go ahead.

titulo.en: Double beds, aircon and big-screen TVs: Indonesia suspends officials over luxury prison cells

sintesis.es: Indonesia’s prisons have long faced allegations that well-connected inmates can obtain preferential treatment through bribery Five Indonesian prison officials have been suspended after investigators found an apartment-style compound complete with airconditioners, big-screen televisions and expensive cars allegedly used by inmates at a prison near Jakarta. “We found strong indications that certain prisoners had access to special facilities unavailable to ordinary prisoners,” said Syafrida Rachmawati Rasahan, a member of Indonesia’s ombudsman, on Tuesday. “We encountered prisoners inside the residential compound and discovered facilities resembling home stays, apartments and villas rather than prison housing.” Continue reading...

titulo.es: La economía argentina bajo Milei muestra fuertes contrastes: cierre de empresas y caída del consumo frente a crecimiento en sectores primarios
titulo.en: Argentina's economy under Milei shows sharp contrasts: business closures and falling consumption versus growth in primary sectors

sintesis.es: Diversos reportajes analizan la economía argentina bajo el gobierno de Javier Milei, señalando el cierre de miles de empresas y una caída histórica en el consumo de carne debido a la pérdida de poder adquisitivo. En paralelo, el gobierno impulsa el crecimiento en sectores primarios como minería y energía, generando una economía 'a dos velocidades' que rediseña la matriz productiva del país. Además, Milei busca posicionar a Argentina como un espacio regulatorio flexible para el desarrollo de inteligencia artificial.
sintesis.en: Multiple reports analyze Argentina's economy under President Javier Milei, highlighting the closure of thousands of businesses and a historic drop in meat consumption due to declining purchasing power. Meanwhile, the government promotes growth in primary sectors like mining and energy, creating a 'two-speed' economy that is reshaping the country's productive structure. Additionally, Milei is positioning Argentina as a rules-free hub for artificial intelligence development.
